card.name: Inside drug names before the ending
card.fires_on: The next-to-last piece of a drug name that is still unfinished, such as the roc in Maraviroc, the ast in rosuvastatin, montelukast or zafirlukast, the ir in simeprevir, or the rex in pemetrexed. It appears in drug-interaction and dosing text.

modes.label: -ast drug names
modes.description: The ast piece inside statin and leukotriene-blocker names.
modes.example: The dose of rosuv<<ast>>atin should not exceed 10 mg

modes.label: Antiviral and other names
modes.description: The roc, ir or rex piece inside names such as maraviroc, simeprevir and pemetrexed.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly unrelated Chinese-language words.
card.plain: It fires partway through a long drug name, just before the name's ending is completed.
